thread:
Diego Ramos: Quick sync — can we align on an ISV integration compatibility matrix + joint announcement timeline? Need owners for: LangChain connector, LlamaIndex adaptor, Gateway auth flow, and marketplace listing prep. Can owners reply with current status + blockers? Goal: internal preview by Wed next week, public announcement ~2 weeks after that.

Priya Shah: I can own the LangChain connector. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/langchain-connector.
Blocker: need a canonical streaming contract for function-calling and streaming partial tokens. Any reference?

Emma Li: I’ll take the LlamaIndex adaptor. Quick Q — which model variants are we certifying for the adaptor (e.g., low-latency quantized vs full-precision)? also need a small eval prompt set to validate retrieval quality.

Mateo Chen: Gateway auth flow -> I’ll take it. Do we want to ship OIDC or API-key first? My recommendation: API-key first to unblock customers, add OIDC in the next sprint.

Diego Ramos: API-key first sounds right. Add a security review item for OIDC scope. @IntegrationBot can you open a tracking ticket for the integration matrix + timeline?

IntegrationBot: Created ticket PART-834: "ISV integration compatibility matrix + announcement timeline" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-834

Alice Nguyen: Marketplace listing + co-marketing draft — I’ll own. I need logos, short integration description, and any compliance notes (SOC2 / data handling) to include. @Emma can you share the required license/attribution text for LlamaIndex?

Emma Li: Yep, will paste license snippet and suggested attribution below. Also attaching a short sample attribution we can include in marketplace metadata.

Priya Shah: Streaming contract (minimal) — feel free to reuse:
```json
{
  "type": "stream_start",
  "model": "redwood-large-v1",
  "stream_id": "uuid",
  "events": [
    {"type": "partial_tokens", "payload": "..."},
    {"type": "function_call", "name": "get_price", "args": {}}
  ]
}
```
This should cover partial token frames + function-call frames.

Diego Ramos: Great — Priya, please add that snippet to PART-834. Next steps: owners add a 1-line status update to the ticket by EOD Friday. Internal preview scheduled Wed (team + eng + legal). Public announcement target two weeks after internal preview.

Mateo Chen: On it — I’ll prototype API-key flow today, ETA EOD Thu. Will also add a note about rate-limiting and token quota defaults.

IntegrationBot: Reminder: Sync standup tomorrow 10:00am PT in #partnerships. Ticket PART-834 updated with initial checklist.

Alice Nguyen: I’ll start the marketplace draft and ping design for logos. If anyone has a preferred one-sentence value prop for the marketplace, drop it in this thread. :sparkles:

Emma Li: Draft value prop: "Redwood + LlamaIndex: fast, production-ready retrieval augmented inference with predictable latency and cost."

Diego Ramos: Perfect. Thanks everyone — please add your short updates to PART-834 and set blockers there. We’ll review on Wed.
